why: Source: sum profits, apply 10% uplift, sum products, convert millions and divide (4 steps); question: the same four steps on a table of the same shape, so the counts match.

Source: sum three labelled waterfall bars, compound the total over 10 years, halve it for the threshold, test 10% and 15% options to find the minimum (5 steps); question: the same sum, compounding, halving and two option tests (5 steps).

Source: pick out the indirect segments of five labelled bars while ignoring the bar totals (the trap), sum them, apply the result to GDP (3 steps); question: the same segment selection, sum and multiplication with the same trap (3 steps).

Source: read price, cost and volume off gridlines of an unlabelled dual-axis line chart, compute margin times volume for three options, compare (about 5 steps); question: the same gridline readings on an unlabelled dual-axis chart, three margin-times-volume products and a comparison (about 5 steps).

Source: one-time visitors from people times fraction, divide by visits rather than people (the trap) (2 steps plus trap); question: the same multiplication, the same visits-not-people trap and division (2 steps plus trap).

Source: locate five products' values in two 12-bar labelled charts, compute five ratios, rank them against the options (about 4 steps); question: the same lookup across two 12-bar charts, five ratios and ranking (about 4 steps).

Source: bottles per order, check the discount threshold, convert per-litre prices to per-unit for two sizes, average the two order values (5 steps); question: the same unit count, threshold check, two mL-to-litre conversions and average (5 steps).
Source: sum all 12 revenue bars, sum all 12 headcount bars, divide and convert millions (3 steps); question: the same two whole-chart sums and division with conversion (3 steps).
Source: sum profits, apply 10% uplift, sum products, convert millions and divide (4 steps); question: the same four steps with a 20% uplift, so the counts match.

Source: chain four funnel percentages to get paying clients, compute saving per client from value times reduction times rate, halve it, multiply out (4 steps); question: the same funnel chain, per-hotel saving from kWh times reduction times price, halving and final product (4 steps).
